blurb: This check verifies the ownership, group, and permission bits of five files mandated by the DISA STIG for IBM AIX 7.x — /etc/inetd.conf, /etc/ntp.conf, /etc/group, /etc/hosts, and /etc/syslog.conf. Any file that exists and is more permissive than its rule's ceiling, or owned or grouped by the wrong id, fails; an absent file is not applicable. A wrong-owned or over-permissive config file is a documented hardening gap an auditor will flag.
